one_liner: Agentic document processing platform (API) for parsing, extracting, splitting, and classifying complex documents like PDFs.

auth.notes: Reducto is API-first (document parsing/extraction product); studio.reducto.ai/auth is the account/API-key portal. Exact 'API key' terminology not directly quoted from a fetched page but is standard for this product category and confirmed via pricing/docs pages.

access.notes: Free credits ($150 free usage / 15,000 credits) available on signup with no sales contact required; paid usage-based tiers (Standard $10/1000 pages parse) purchasable online.

api.evidence_quote: One price covers the whole platform: parse, extract, split, classify, and edit.
api.notes: Core product surface: parse, extract, split, classify, edit endpoints. No official or community MCP server confirmed in search results.

verdict.rationale: Self-serve signup with free credits and a documented usage-based REST API, no approval gate found.
